symptoms: Checkout requests timed out after deployment. Database connection pool was saturated.
root_cause: Release demo-v2 leaked database connections on the exception path.
successful_fix: Rolled back demo-v2, then patched connection cleanup using a finally block.
failed_attempts: Restarting instances briefly improved latency, but the pool filled again.
verification: Pool utilization returned below 50 percent and timeout errors stopped during a 15-minute observation window.
